title: Quick & Easy Wholemeal 3-Ingredient Flatbreads
description: Simple pan-fried flatbreads made from just Greek yogurt, wholemeal flour and baking powder, ready in 15 minutes.
steps: Mix all ingredients to form a dough; knead briefly until combined; roll into a ball and divide into 4.
Roll each piece into a ball, then roll out flat to ~15cm diameter.
Place a nonstick frying pan over high heat; when hot, cook first flatbread ~20 seconds each side until golden and slightly puffed.
notes: Add dried oregano, nigella seeds or chilli flakes for flavour. Spread with marinara sauce and grated cheese and grill for a quick pizza.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
